key_insight: ImmunoStruct fuses molecular sequence, 3D structure, and biochemical features in a single multimodal deep learning model to predict immunogenicity, while providing interpretable signals to guide hypothesis generation.
problem_solved: Accurately predicting whether molecules (e.g., peptides, proteins) will trigger immune responses requires integrating heterogeneous data (sequence, structure, chemistry) and producing explanations—this paper addresses the gap by providing a unified, interpretable multimodal prediction framework.
method: Multimodal encoder that jointly represents sequence, structural (3D) and biochemical feature modalities for each molecular candidate.

Model fusion layer produces a consolidated representation used for immunogenicity classification, with built-in interpretability (e.g., attention maps or feature attribution) to highlight driving factors.
Training and evaluation on labeled immunogenicity data to enable both accurate prediction and mechanistic hypothesis generation.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a practical blueprint for building interpretable multimodal models in molecular biology, accelerating safer molecule design and targeted experimental follow-up by showing which sequence/structural features drive immune responses.
visual_elements: Multimodal architecture diagram showing separate encoders for sequence, structure and biochemical features and a fusion module feeding into prediction + interpretation heads.
Side-by-side example: protein structure with overlaid attention/attribution heatmap and corresponding sequence-level highlights to show interpretable drivers of immunogenicity.
Bar/ROC chart comparing ImmunoStruct against baseline unimodal models to illustrate performance gains from multimodality.
Workflow infographic linking model outputs to downstream uses (candidate triage, experimental validation, hypothesis generation).
paper_title: ImmunoStruct enables multimodal deep learning for immunogenicity prediction
paper_authors: Kevin Bijan Givechian, João Felipe Rocha, Chen Liu, Edward Yang, Sidharth Tyagi
